title: Synthesis I: Two Sources, Contrasting Viewpoints
goal: Combine two opposing op-eds into one written answer that represents both sides fairly and states, specifically, where they actually disagree — not just "some people think X, others think Y."
time: 40 min · **Materials:** notebook, Session 6 notes (the phone-ban essay).

questions: What do both essays agree on? Quote the sentence(s) that show the agreement most clearly.
State the specific point of disagreement — not "phones," but the precise scope question both essays are actually arguing about.
Is the disagreement mainly factual, values-based, or about priorities? Defend your answer using both texts' actual content.
